transcript.text:
Thank you all. This has been an extremely productive conference, and I now have the full picture I need before I can approve the demand package. Let me summarize where we are and what needs to happen.

First, on the claims and relief: Thomas, I need the demand package updated with your finalized direct-damages figure from the invoice reconciliation before I sign off. Maya, the non-monetary objectives — restoring access to the implementation environment, return or destruction of source code, and confidentiality protections — are now front and center, and I want those formally reflected in the intake form today as you indicated. Given the supplier's threat to terminate access this month, the equitable relief is time-critical.

Second, on the forum: Daniel's review of the executed schedule confirms this must go to the ICDR in New York before a three-arbitrator panel. That changes our timeline and cost structure, and it means we need to prioritize ICDR emergency or interim measures procedures for the equitable relief — we cannot wait for the full panel to be constituted before seeking interim relief on the access and source code issues.

Third, on conflicts: Iris, the conflicts issue involving the proposed lawyer's prior representation of the supplier's parent company needs to be resolved before I can give final approval. Under our rules, informed written consent from the supplier-side client is required, plus an ethical screen, and I understand you're still confirming the scope of the prior representation. I need that clearance memo as quickly as possible.

To Maya's question about whether the interim measures request can proceed regardless of which lawyers are cleared: I don't want to hold up the interim relief filing on conflicts if we can staff it with lawyers who are already cleared, but I need Iris's input on whether that's feasible under our screening rules. Iris, can you advise on that point?

In the meantime, my directive is this: Thomas, finalize the damages figure and get it into the demand package. Maya, update the intake form with the non-monetary objectives today. Daniel, begin drafting the ICDR arbitration demand with the interim measures framework. Iris, expedite the conflicts clearance memo and advise on whether we can proceed with cleared lawyers on the interim filing. Once all four items are resolved, I will approve the finalized demand package.
